guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Enovis updated financial expectations for 2026. Revenue guidance is narrowed to a range of $2.32-2.35 billion, versus prior expectations of $2.31-2.37 billion. Revenue guidance incorporates 5% organic revenue growth, as compared to 4-6% previously. Adjusted EBITDA guidance is raised to a range of $428-438 million, as compared to the prior outlook of $425-435 million. The guidance ranges for revenue

and adjusted EBITDA are based on current exchange rates. Enovis now expects foreign currency to be a benefit to revenue growth of 0.5%-1.0%, as compared to 0.5%-1.5% previously. Full-year adjusted earnings per share guidance is raised from $3.52-3.73 to $3.58-3.79. Full year free cash flow conversion is expected to be 25% or higher.
